note: Triennial election of the county council, 1949: nominations 17 May 1949; the only contest was Armagh City, polled 2 June 1949. The Armagh Guardian lists give no party labels, so none are given for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed. New member. Frederick N. L. Bell: no party label printed in 1949. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Bessbrook North, Newry No. 2 Rural District, 2 June 1949, printed 'Unionist': Newry Telegraph, 4 June 1949, p. 7 ("Rural Council Elections: contests in Newry No. 2 and Kilkeel districts; result of the polling"); Newry Telegraph, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council (election nominations)")).
